purpose: Exploratory Google TabFM 91-day screen; production defaults remain unchanged.

tabfm_google.feature_recipe: For every complete historical 91-day origin, direct rows use horizon_step, absolute trend_days, target day_of_week/month/day_of_month/day_of_year, target lag_364 sales, and origin trailing 28/91-day means. Prediction rows use the same fields at the registered cutoff. Every target-derived feature date is on or before its row origin; no recursive short lags, supplied covariates, future actuals, tuning, or feature selection.

execution_contract.full_screen_requires: successful local CUDA smoke with the exact pinned package/checkpoint and no fallback or degraded output
execution_contract.same_window_requirement: Candidate dates and actuals must match the registered baseline grid exactly.
execution_contract.no_tuning: No weight, feature, context, checkpoint or candidate changes after scoring.
execution_contract.failure_rule: Import, license, checkpoint, CUDA, memory, shape, non-finite or date-alignment failures are recorded as blocked/failed and produce no scored candidate row.
execution_contract.decision_rule: This is a requested exploratory extension. Report mean/median WAPE, bias, wins and worst-window loss versus naive and the frozen TimesFM blend; do not promote or tune from these overlapping historical windows.
